name: Scenarios added by Claude (beyond the handoff)

scenarios.trigger: The winning team's final lead change comes in the last period with 1 second or less left.
The winning team's final lead change comes in the last period with 1-5 seconds left.
The winner trailed by 20 or more at some point.
A regular-season stat line beats the league single-game record that stood when the save began (real record book: points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, threes, free throws).
scenarios.evidence: test-events.js: 101 breaks Wilt's 100; 1961-62 save starts with Baylor's 71

scenarios.trigger: A regular-season stat line equals the standing league record.
A made four-point shot plus a shooting foul and made free throw (four-point line rule).
Coaches sit players in foul trouble (2 fouls in Q1, 3 in Q2, 4 in Q3, 5 in Q4 before crunch time) and players in foul trouble defend more carefully.
scenarios.evidence: foul-outs fell from 0.53 to ~0.19 per team-game; PF ~19.6

scenarios.trigger: Possessions with under 2 seconds are heaves; under 4 seconds are rushed.
Your player wins an MVP, DPOY, ROY, statistical title or championship that went to someone else in real history.
